tray.iconMissing: The notification area icon could not be loaded.
tray.iconMissingDetail: Please reinstall Timon to restore the icon. You can keep using this window; closing it will quit Timon.

about.title: About Rooks
about.noticesMissing: THIRD-PARTY-MODELS.md is missing from this installation. Reinstall Timon to restore it.

waiting.title: Starting Timon…
waiting.hint: The first launch can take a moment.
waiting.restartHint: Timon is handing over to its background service. Setup continues in a moment.
waiting.verifyingHint: Timon checks that its files are intact. With antivirus software, this can take up to a minute.
waiting.failedDetail: Read the message shown, then quit and reopen Timon.

startup.missingDetail: Expected at {path}. This build is incomplete — reinstall {app}, or start a daemon yourself and set daemon.supervisor in timon.config.json.
startup.reopenTray: reopen the window from the {app} icon in the notification area{when, select, moment { in a moment} minute { in a minute} other {}}
startup.reopenRelaunch: quit {app} and launch it again{when, select, moment { in a moment} minute { in a minute} other {}}
startup.uiMissing: The interface did not come up.
startup.uiMissingDetail:
{giveUp}

The daemon may be running without its web app: quit and reopen Timon. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.
startup.crashingDetail:
{why}

The bundled daemon could not start. Your data remains in {home}.
startup.slow: The daemon did not answer in time.
startup.slowDetail: Started in portable mode but {origin} stayed silent for {seconds}s. It may still be migrating its database — {reopen}.
startup.portTakenDetail:
Something answers on that address but does not identify itself as this {app} data directory.

Set daemon.listen.port (and app.listen.port) to free ports in {config}, then {reopen}.
startup.silentDetail:
Expected at {origin}, supervised by {supervisor}; nothing answered within {seconds} s. It may still be starting (a first launch after an update checks the installation and the providers), or it may have failed: {reopen}, and if it stays silent, read its log.

{logHint} Your data has been preserved.
startup.logSupervisor: Check the daemon supervisor configured for this installation.
startup.logMissingWindows: It has not written a log yet: check that the {task} task exists and is enabled in Task Scheduler.
startup.logMissingMac: It has not written a log yet: check that the {service} service is loaded (launchctl list).
startup.upgradeFailed: The background service could not be updated to version {version}.
startup.upgradeFallbackDetail:
Timon runs its built-in daemon for this session and will try again at the next launch. Your agents, missions and projects in {home} were not modified.

{reason}
startup.upgradeKeptDetail:
Timon keeps using the background service it already had and will try again at the next launch. Your agents, missions and projects in {home} were not modified.

{reason}

diagnostic.copied: Diagnostic copied to the clipboard: paste it in your support request (Discord, e-mail).
diagnostic.copiedLinux: Diagnostic copied. Paste it now (Discord, e-mail) before clicking OK: on Linux the clipboard empties when Timon quits.
diagnostic.openFailed: Could not open the logs folder
diagnostic.preparingDetail: Timon is gathering the logs and checks. This can take up to a minute when the service does not answer.
diagnostic.title: Support diagnostic
diagnostic.detail: Copy it or save it, then attach it to your support request.

service.stopItem: Quit and stop the background service
service.stopDetail: Running missions are interrupted, and nothing runs until you open Timon again, which starts the service back.
service.stopPermissionMac: macOS may ask for an administrator password.
service.stopFailed: The background service was not stopped.
service.stopFailedDetail: Timon stays open and the service keeps running.
service.startFailed: The background service is stopped and could not be started again.
service.startFailedDetail: You stopped it with “Quit and stop the background service”. Open Timon again and allow the prompt, or run timon service start. Your data in {home} is intact.
service.handoverKept: The Timon background service did not answer.
service.handoverKeptDetail: Setup continues with Timon as it runs in this window. Quit and reopen Timon once setup is finished: it tries the service again. Your data remains in {home}.
service.refused: Windows does not start the Timon background service for this account.
service.refusedDetail: The TimonOrchestrator scheduled task is registered, but Windows has never run it. This happens with work or school accounts on a PC joined to Microsoft Entra ID. Timon runs its built-in daemon instead: it starts with the app and stops when you close it or sign out. To remove the unused task: timon service uninstall (Windows asks for permission).
service.repair: The Timon background service is no longer installed.
service.repairDetail: Without it, Timon does not start with Windows and stops when you close the app or sign out. Reinstalling it asks for Windows permission once.
service.repairFailed: The background service could not be reinstalled.
service.repairFailedDetail: Timon runs its built-in daemon for this session and will offer it again at the next launch. Your data in {home} was not modified.

staleShell.detail: {appName} still runs the version it started with. Quit it completely, then open it again to use the one you just launched. Until then, no new window can open.

unload.detail: A document you opened has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you continue.

backup.partial: Timon backed up your data before updating them, but not your plugins.
backup.failed: Timon could not back up your data before updating them.

restore.message: Your data were last used by Timon {newer}.
restore.detail:
This is Timon {appVersion}. A copy of your data was saved on {when}, just before Timon {newer} opened them.

Restoring puts your agents, missions, projects and settings back as they were in that copy. Everything done in Timon since that date will be lost. Your current data are kept in {kept}.

Continuing keeps everything, but Timon {appVersion} may ignore what version {newer} added.
restore.notRestoredDetail: Timon continues with the current data, which were not modified.
restore.pending: The restore will run the next time the Timon service starts.

update.title: Update Timon from {from} to {to}
update.detail: Timon will prepare the service, back up your data, then migrate them for this version.
update.intact: Before approval, the database and its journals, configuration, plugins and their data, version and approval markers, service and installed releases remain intact. Only the data directory and Electron profile/cache may be created.
update.quitDetail: Quitting leaves your data intact. To return to the previous version, reinstall its installer.
update.missions: {count, plural, one {# mission is running} other {# missions are running}} on Timon {from}. Updating now stops {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Wait quits this window and leaves {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} running: open Timon again once {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} done.
update.waiting: Backing up and migrating your data. This may take several minutes…
update.stillStarting: Timon is taking longer than expected to start.
update.stillStartingDetail: The update completed and your data were migrated, but the service has not answered yet. Quit Timon and reopen it in a minute; if it still does not answer after a few minutes, run the support diagnostic.
update.failureDetail: The service may have been replaced and approval recorded. If migration started, data may have changed. No automatic data rollback was performed. Read the message below, then quit and reopen Timon.
update.failureDetailNotSent: Nothing was sent to the Timon service: no service was replaced and your data were not modified. Read the message below, then quit and reopen Timon.
update.failureDetailServiceOnly: The service may have been replaced by this version, but the approval was not sent to it: the migration did not start and your data were not modified. Read the message below, then quit and reopen Timon.

uninstall.stops: Agents, workflows and browsers will stop. Connected PWAs will be disconnected.
uninstall.deletes: All contents of this directory will be permanently deleted: {home}
uninstall.outside: Projects and configurations outside this directory are preserved.
uninstall.incomplete: Uninstall is incomplete. No data was erased.
uninstall.incompleteDetail: Quit and reopen Timon to restart it.
uninstall.finishMac: To finish, move Timon.app to the Trash in Finder. Do not reopen Timon before removing it.
uninstall.finishWindows: To finish, remove Timon in Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps.
uninstall.finishAppImage: To finish, delete the AppImage file: {path}
uninstall.finishLinux: To finish, uninstall the Timon package using your distribution’s software manager.
uninstall.done: Timon is stopped and its service has been removed.
uninstall.leftover: The dictation model could not be removed. Delete this folder yourself:
uninstall.cleanupIncomplete: Cleanup is incomplete. Remaining data is in {home}.

speech.packWarning: Timon checks the files after the download but cannot vouch for a third-party model: only install models from plugins you trust.

bubble.hint: Enter to add · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to cancel
bubble.noConversation: Open this browser from a conversation to send.
bubble.sendFailed: The annotations could not be sent.
bubble.saveFailed: The annotation could not be saved.
bubble.full: The queue is full: send it before adding more.
